title: Change formatPrice to take a Money object

source.note: Written by the repository author for v0.4.0 (repo-snapshot case).

input.objective: We keep passing amount and currency separately and twice shipped bugs where they were swapped between two different prices. Introduce a Money value ({cents, currency}) and make formatPrice take it.
input.context: Storefront (Node.js 20, ESM JavaScript with JSDoc types checked by `tsc --noEmit`). formatPrice() lives in src/money.js.

ground_truth.material_issue: src/invoice.js still calls formatPrice(line.cents, invoice.currency); with the new signature invoices render garbage / throw. tsc reports the wrong call in invoice.js; tests do not cover invoices.
required_observations: invoice.js still uses the old two-argument signature
